name: cheerful-cad-review
description: LLM tools for dual-path CAD review: parse DXF/STL, then orbit-capture PNG views to double-confirm.

tools.name: cad_summary
tools.description: Parse DXF (layers, entities, circles) or STL (bbox, triangle count). Use this for dimensions and design intent.

tools.name: capture_views
tools.description: Control the 3D camera through several poses and save PNG screenshots so a vision model can double-check the mesh against the drawing.
